item.title: Gilgeous-Alexander’s 43 points and late 3 hand Cavaliers their first home loss
item.dc:creator: Basketball Insiders Editor
item.description:
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored a season-high 43 points and hit the go-ahead 3-pointer as the injury-hit Thunder beat Cleveland 117-112. With Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Chet Holmgren all sidelined long term, the win was Oklahoma City's first without them, and the teams meet again on Wednesday.
